versions.revisionNotes: Reference condition is the fixed landscape-pressure screen least-disturbed-v1 (strict), wadeable non-canal frame. 12 of 58 stations of this ecoregion pass. 5 reference curves use local stations, 10 borrow from a wider region, 5 metrics use fixed criteria, and 0 metrics are withheld for insufficient reference support.
